content: India RERA best practices for builder sites (2026: Vikilinks, scaleacres x2, magicbricks, Eldeco EOE, Bulwark Highgrove): display RERA registration number prominently per project page + link to state portal + QR where required; possession date must match official filing; every advertised amenity must be in approved plan; label 3D/renders 'artist's impression'; no ads/bookings before registration; state starting price with basis/area/update date/exclusions; construction-linked payment plans common (30:40:30); FAQ categories typically: configurations/areas, booking & payment, possession & handover, RERA, amenities, investment, NRI buying (NRE/NRO, PoA, virtual tours for remote buyers). Monthly verification checklist for prices/status/approvals/wording. Generalizes beyond India to any regulated market (Pakistan/GCC have equivalents).
